text:
maria: Heads-up — proposing a reshuffle of console telemetry storage to reduce read amplification on per-route dashboards. Goal: introduce a compact partitioned table + dual-write, canary, then backfill + cutover.

maria: Rough plan: create route_metrics_compact_v2 (tenant_id partitioned), dual-write for 48h, enable shadow reads for 24h on canary tenants (5%), then bulk backfill in low-traffic windows.

maria: snippet: ```sql
CREATE TABLE route_metrics_compact_v2 (route_id uuid, tenant_id uuid, ts timestamptz, p99_latency_ms int, tokens int, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, ts)) PARTITION BY LIST (tenant_id);
-- backfill: INSERT INTO route_metrics_compact_v2 SELECT ... FROM route_metrics WHERE ts < now() - interval '1h';
```

jamal: +1 to dual-write. prefer shadow-read approach (read from compact_v2 only for canary tenants) before flipping any UI queries. avoids accidental perf cliffs. :eyes:

kevin: main risk is backfill IO and p99 spikes on the metrics service. current console dashboard p99 ~180ms; if we run big inserts it will push CPU. we need: rate-limited backfill, controlled worker concurrency, and circuit breaker on CPU > 75%.

kevin: also question on query contract: are we changing any field names? we should keep getters stable — prefer alias columns to avoid console code churn.

maria: agreed re: aliases. no semantic changes in payload. only denser encoding + partitioning. will add view route_metrics_compact that exposes same column names.

sara: rollout UX: recommend a small canary (5% tenants), enable shadow-read flag, show both old/new results side-by-side in a dashboard for 24h, and add a regression alert for p95/p99 mismatch > 5%. if OK, increase to 25% then 100%.

ops-ci: backfill estimate: with 8 workers (r5-like) ~6-8 hours per shard range. command: `./bin/backfill --table route_metrics_compact_v2 --from 2026-03-01 --to now --concurrency 8 --rate 2000`

ops-ci: will run initial backfill in staging tomorrow night, can run prod dry-run against a small tenant slice first.

jamal: also we should plan for query adapter in API: add a short-circuit that routes reads to compact_v2 when feature flag `compact_route_reads` is true for tenant. rollback = flip flag off.

kevin: add integration test to ensure view preserves NULL/absent semantics (we had a bug last time where missing tags turned into 0).

maria: deployment schedule proposal: staging canary -> monitoring window -> prod canary (5%) -> shadow-read 24h -> backfill low traffic window -> full cutover.

maria: I'll open an RFC doc with exact timings, DDL, and backout steps. tagging @ops-ci @kevin for review. :shipit:

deploy-bot: Deploy planned: staging/schema-change-canary at 1798920000. Automated smoke tests will run post-deploy.

sara: dashboards to add: 
- console.telemetry.compare.{p50,p95,p99} (old vs compact_v2)
- infra.db.backfill.throughput and infra.db.cpu.by_shard
- alerts: console.telemetry.p99.regression and backfill.job.failures

maria: decision: proceed with staging canary tomorrow, prod dry-run on 10 tenants after signoff. leaving thread open for any last blockers.

kevin: ack, will review RFC and tests today.

jamal: I'll wire up the feature-flag gating and the shadow-read adapter.

ops-ci: prepping K8s job manifest and setting low-priority QoS class for backfill pods. will post manifests here when ready.

maria: thanks everyone. posting RFC link shortly and scheduling a short sync if needed.
